app.name: Isharah
app.tagline: One lecture, understood by every student
app.description: An AI platform making university lectures accessible to deaf and blind students in real-time

hero.title: Isharah
hero.subtitle: One lecture, understood by every student
hero.description: An AI platform that translates university lectures into 3D sign language for deaf students, and provides intelligent audio descriptions of visual content for blind students — all in real-time.

problem.title: The Problem We're Solving
problem.description: Over 2.7 million students with hearing or visual disabilities in Saudi Arabia face enormous barriers in university education. No specialized tools make lectures truly accessible to them.
points: Deaf students cannot follow spoken lecture content
Blind students cannot understand visual content
Existing technologies are generic and lack proper Arabic support

features.title: A solution designed for every student

deaf.title: Deaf Student
deaf.description: A real-time 3D avatar translating the lecture into Saudi Sign Language, with synchronized captions.

blind.title: Blind Student
blind.description: AI-generated audio descriptions of slides and visual content, with full voice command and keyboard support.

sighted.title: Sighted Student
sighted.description: Live captions and auto-generated summaries every 2 minutes, plus a review question bank at session end.

steps.title: Lecturer starts session
steps.description: The lecturer opens the dashboard and starts a session to get a unique code

steps.title: Students join
steps.description: Each student enters the session code and chooses their preferred interface type

steps.title: AI works in real-time
steps.description: Claude analyzes speech and images and generates appropriate content for each student

steps.title: Learning without barriers
steps.description: Every student receives the lecture in the way that suits them in real-time

cta.title: Ready to experience Isharah?
cta.description: Start a demo now and see how AI can make education accessible to everyone.

footer.built_for: Built for Eduthon 3 — King Khalid University
footer.powered_by: Powered by Claude AI from Anthropic
